subject: When is the cluster argument needed?

messages.author: b430763ad49e6cd0
messages.subject: When is the cluster argument needed?
parts:
Hi all, 

Is it needed to use the cluster argument when building CFA models?
Today I realized I never did this, while my dataset consists of 120+ individuals, measured over 4 time points.
Should I define cluster = 'individuals' in the CFA() or Lavaan() function? 

Or is this cluster argument only useful for multilevel models that is currently not yet fully supported by Lavaan? 

You'll be a life saver if you help me out here :) since I have a deadline already next week. 

Thanks,
Amonet

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: When is the cluster argument needed?
parts:
How are you analyzing the data? If the data are wide -as in, you identify time through the variable labels you don't need the cluster command.

If the data are long (i.e. you have a variable called (something like) time, you need to take into account that you have repeated observations of the same people. However you only have 4 observations, which is not many.

(I would probably treat the data as wide, unless you have a large number of variables.) 

Jeremy
